【原视频简介】
Being a Green Lantern is tricky business as it is. With a responsibility to act against all forms of evil, the ring bearer must use the insane power at his disposal, and the temptations are far too many. This is why I have always wondered what would be the effect of wearing multiple Lantern rings at once? I mean the first thing that comes to mind is a massive power surge, but things don’t necessarily work that way, and luckily, I have found the answers in the comics because this has actually happened a few times. Yes, it is possible to wield multiple Lantern rings at once, and one can possibly wear multiple Green Lantern rings, and also mix different colors together, and the effects will leave you surprised.
